scope: Bounded current-gp4 approach qualification at seed 1: Arrows fast corridor and western bypass, Broken southern hazard enclosure, Crossing central connections and western belt enclosure; three presets and both controls. Each prefix is played at its actual preset/control speed. Diagnostics reproduce recorded failures or unfinished routes rather than treating them as qualified clears. This is not an exhaustive seed/timing search or human balance evidence. Neon and Twin alternate-preset extensions were not attempted in this increment.
